L196: When you have a product to sell and it’s time to get it out into the world, there’s plenty to consider. If you’ve signed up for an Amazon selling account, one of the most important steps is building an Amazon product detail page that captures customers’ attention.
L197: 
L198: But where do you start? With this guide, you’ll learn the ins and outs of creating Amazon product listings, including:
L199:   * The step-by-step process for creating a new product detail page
L200:   * Tools you can use to optimize your product listing
L201:   * Tricks to help your product stand out
L202:   * Other ways to list products
L203: ## What are Amazon product listings?
L204: 
L205: 【62†Image: Product detail page in the Amazon store†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L206: 
L207: An Amazon product listing is made up of two basic parts: a product detail page and the offers paired with it.
L208:   * A product detail page showcases a product people can buy in the Amazon store. It includes the product name, images, description, and more. The more in-depth your product detail page, the more informed your customer can be about their purchase.
L209:   * Each seller’s offer for a product is viewable on or from the same product detail page. Offers includes pricing and shipping information, along with any promotion details.
L210: ## 3 steps for creating new Amazon product listings
L211: 
L212: Have you been wondering how to create a new product detail page in the Amazon store? As a 【6†registered Amazon seller】, your ability to create a new product detail page may depend on your relationship with the product:
L213:   * If the product is part of a brand enrolled in 【18†Amazon Brand Registry】, you need to be a 【63†Brand Representative or Reseller authorized by the brand】 to list it using our standard processes.
L214:   * If the product belongs to certain categories, you may be prompted during the listing process to 【64†obtain approval from Amazon†sellercentral.amazon.com】.
L215: 
L216: When you meet the requirements for a product, you can create its detail page by following these steps:
L217: ### 1. Search for your product
L218: 
L219: 【65†Image: Lo-fi image of main menu in Amazon Seller Central with path to listing tool highlighted†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L220: 
L221: Hover over Catalog in the main menu of Seller Central, then click Add Products. From the Add Product page, 【66†enter your GTIN or product ID】 into the search field. If your product doesn’t appear in search listings, click Create a new listing under the search field.
L222: 
L223: Did you know?
L224: 
L225: You can list products with the free Amazon Seller mobile app
L226: The Amazon Seller mobile app lets you add new products to your inventory and make adjustments to your current offers—right from your mobile device. You can download the Amazon Seller mobile app for iPhone on the Apple Store or for Android on Google Play.
L227: 
L228: 【67†Learn more about the Amazon Seller mobile app】
L229: ### 2. Fill out product information
L230: 
L231: You’ll fill out multiple tabs to create an informative product detail page. You’ll have the opportunity to add keywords to 【68†optimize your product for search】. You can also create 【69†variation relationships†sellercentral.amazon.com】 to connect products that come in different versions for size, color, or another attribute. (We cover both topics in more depth below).
L232: 
L233: Here’s an overview of sections you’ll need to complete:
L234: #### Product Identity
L235: 
L236: This tab covers basic information about your product, including the product name, type, the item type keywords, whether or not it has variations, and brand name.
L237: #### Product Description
L238: 
L239: 【70†Image: Lo-fi image of an Amazon product detail page†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L240: 
L241: Here’s where you’ll describe your product.
L242:   * First up is the Product Description, where you’ll share a paragraph that tells customers what your product is. Think of the product description as a broad strokes overview of your product and its benefits.
L243:   * Bullet Points come next. These are an opportunity to get more detailed, with up to five bullets that highlight your product’s most important details and attributes.
L244:   * Images are important to give your customers an accurate view of what you’re selling. You can upload up to nine photos—the more, the better. You can arrange your images in the order you want them to appear on your product detail page once you’ve uploaded all of them. (We’ll talk more about images below.)
L245: #### Product Details
L246: 
L247: This tab is where you fill out additional information like how many items are sold under each unit, the number of components involved, and the color. The required information can differ from product to product.
L248: #### Offer
L249: 
L250: 【71†Image: Lo-fi image of a product listing tool inside Amazon Seller Central†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L251: 
L252: In this tab, you’ll share the Quantity of items for sale, Price, Condition (whether it’s new or used), and the Fulfillment Channel. You’ll have two options to choose from: 【72†Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)】, in which Amazon handles packing, shipping, customer service, and returns, or 【27†Fulfilled by Merchant】, where you handle everything yourself.
L253: #### Safety and Compliance
L254: 
L255: The information you share in this tab will depend on your product. If it’s a safety hazard for children under a certain age, has safety certifications, needs batteries or has other required components, it’s important to note that here. Select products may need to meet certain requirements or hazmat regulations.

L257: Pro Tip
L258: 
L259: Try generative AI
L260: Need help writing product content? You can 【73†use our generative AI features†www.aboutamazon.com】 that can help you create compelling titles, descriptions, and other attributes from a few words, image, or existing listings.
L261: ### 3. Save as draft or Submit
L262: 
L263: If you’re ready to create your page, review your details and click Submit. Want to come back to it later? Choose Save as draft so you can go back to make edits.

L279: ## How do I optimize my Amazon listings?
L280: 
L281: Creating a product listing is an important first step in making your product available. But if you really want customers to find you, there are some additional steps you can take to 【78†optimize your listing】, including:
L282: ### Make your product images pop
L283: 
L284: Having accurate and illustrative product images is key to a successful 【79†ecommerce business】. In general, you want to make sure your product is showcased against a simple backdrop and well-lit so customers can really see what you’re selling. Images should be sharp and clear, ideally in high resolution. Follow 【80†our tips for taking product photos】 to help your listing stand out.
L285: ### Use customer-friendly search terms
L286: 
L287: Adding high-ranking search terms or keywords can help customers find your Amazon product listing through search results. You can use keywords in your product titles, descriptions, bullet points, and more.
L288: You can do your own keyword research using online tools that track popular search terms. Or you can enroll you brand in 【18†Amazon Brand Registry】, a free program that makes you eligible to access tools like 【21†Brand Analytics】. Brand Analytics includes dashboards like Search Query Performance and Top Search Terms, so you can learn what customers are searching for and the terms they use to search for those items.
L289: 
L290: 【68†Learn more ways to improve your product’s search rankings】
L291: ### Get product reviews
L292: 
L293: Product reviews can have a big influence on a customer’s purchasing decisions. The more reviews and the higher rating you have, the better the chance that customers will shop with you. But how do you get great reviews?
L294: In addition to offering stellar customer service, swiftly resolving issues, and being communicative when customers need you, you can also enroll in 【20†Amazon Vine】. The Vine program is also available to enrolled brands and helps you generate 【81†high-quality reviews】 by providing products to a trusted network of reviewers who try products free of charge and in return share their honest, unbiased opinions in a review.
L295: ### Boost your engagement
L296: 
L297: 【82†Image: Lo-fi image of Habit Vitamins product detail page with A+ Content†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L298: Having the right keywords and eye-catching pictures can go a long way in attracting customers, but you can take your listings to the next level by adding 【19†A+ Content】. Also available to brands enrolled in Brand Registry, A+ Content is a tool that helps you showcase your products and share your brand’s story by adding videos, enhanced images, customized text placements, shoppable product-comparison charts, and more to your product detail pages.
L299: Use A+ Content to enhance your listings, drive brand awareness, encourage repeat purchases, and increase sales.
L300: Did you know?
L301: 
L302: Amazon Brand Registry can help increase the accuracy of product listings
L303: 
L304: After enrolling your brand in Amazon Brand Registry, only you and other sellers associated with your brand can create or suggest updates to your product detail pages using our standard listing processes. That helps ensure the accuracy of your product information and improves the customer experience.
L305: 
L306: 【18†Learn more and enroll in Brand Registry】
L307: ## Other listing options
L308: 
L309: In addition to creating new detail pages for products one at a time, here are some other options for listing products with Amazon:
L310: ### Match an offer to an existing product detail page
L311: 
L312: If you want to run a 【83†resale business】, there may already be an active Amazon listing for the product you want to sell. In that case, you can just match your offer to the existing product detail page, setting your price and filling out other offer information. In some cases, you may need to obtain approval for a brand or category before matching an offer.
L313: One of the easiest ways to find out whether or not the product you want to sell already has an Amazon product listing is by 【84†using the Amazon seller app to scan UPCs and barcodes】. The app takes a picture of a product’s barcode using your smartphone camera. If there’s already a product listing associated with the item you want to sell, you can add your offer to the page right from the app.
L314: ### Build bulk product listings
L315: 
L316: If you have multiple listings you want to create, you can do so with 【85†our bulk listing feature†sellercentral.amazon.com】. By creating a spreadsheet that includes all of your products, you can create and match multiple product listings at the same time, then use your spreadsheet to update and manage them.
L317: You can update thousands of listings simultaneously. For example, let’s say you sell baseball caps in a variety of different styles and colors, but you’ll no longer offer them in red. Just delete that option from your spreadsheet, and the product listing associated with that color will be removed.

L333: ### Listing product variations
L334: 
L335: 【90†Image: Lo-fi image of the Variation Wizard tool inside Amazon Seller Central†cdn.sell2.brightspotcdn.com】
L336: 
L337: Offering 【91†product variations】 makes it easier for you to share different versions of the same product on your product detail page. For example, if you offer a phone that comes in five different colors, you can have one listing that showcases all the available colors on the same page.
L338: One easy way to do this is by using the Variation Wizard in Seller Central. 【92†The Variation Wizard†sellercentral.amazon.com】 is an interactive tool that allows you to create parent-child variation relationships in bulk using an auto-populated inventory file template. You can easily add or update an existing variation, or create a new variation family by combining existing standalone listings within your catalog.

L354: Start creating product listings today
L355: Creating a compelling product listing is the first step to attracting customers to your ecommerce business. While every product page shares the same general information, there are still ways you can make yours unique. Amazon offers a variety of tools to help you make a product detail page that stands out.
L356: From offering AI assistance in crafting your descriptions to providing access to SEO keyword insights and A+ Content, you can get everything you need to support your ecommerce business and make your product listings shine.

L358: #### Frequently Asked Questions: Amazon product listings
L359: 
L360: Q:
L361: 
L362: ###### Is listing a product on Amazon free?
L363: 
L364: A:
L365: 
L366: While it’s free to list a product on Amazon, there are 【13†fees associated with being an Amazon seller】. There are two plans to choose from: An Individual plan that costs $0.99 per item sold and a Professional plan that costs $39.99 per month no matter how many items you sell. Each option comes with access to a selection of tools and services to support your selling journey.
L367: 
L368: Q:
L369: ###### Can I sell just one item on Amazon?
L370: 
L371: A:
L372: 
L373: You can sell as many or as few items as you like—all you need is a detailed Amazon product page that accurately showcases what you’re selling. 【97†Amazon selling plans】 are flexible to meet your needs, allowing you to change plans as your needs change.
L374: 
L375: Q:
L376: ###### What products are sellable on Amazon?
L377: 
L378: A:
L379: 
L380: You can sell many different products with Amazon. There are some products you may need approval to sell, and others that require a Professional selling account. There are also 【98†some product restrictions†sellercentral.amazon.com】, such as products that can’t be sold by third-party sellers or products that need to meet certain compliance rules.
L381: 
L382: Q:
L383: ###### What is the list price on Amazon?
L384: 
L385: A:
L386: 
L387: The list price for your product on Amazon is up to you. When you create an Amazon product listing, you determine the list price when you fill out your offer details.
